description: Committee to review City Council advisory committee mandates.
Review includes funding and co-sponsorship processes.
Advisory Committees must submit 2027 work plans and budget requests.
New process links committee work plans to budgets.
Submissions are due by October 1 annually for Council review.
Committee will consider a follow-up report from Wild About Saskatoon.
Report details Pollinator Paradise YXE event held May 31, 2026.
Committee is asked to provide direction on the report.

chips.text: Report follows up on Pollinator Paradise YXE event, promoting pollinator health.
